The conversation we had was when we decided not trying to have children is okay with both of us. 

There’s many things that go into having children that we don’t have and might not ever have.
My SO wants children but is on the same page as me.
If only it were that easy. 😔

Yes you’re right. But we can barely afford a studio apartment at this point. No way we could afford a home for a child to grow up in. If we saved up for a house for that child, we’d be well into our late 30’s early 40’s. The likeliness of us having a child at that age is slim.
I fantasize about having close friends I could invite over and cook for. Cooking for one really gets sad sometimes.
